items.title: Data-Driven Analysis of Arrow Properties & Shooting Performance
bullets: Designed a multi-angle measurement protocol and collected spine-deflection data from 21 arrows using an electronic spine tester and a custom rotation guide.
Modeled angular deflection with second-order Fourier series; engineered mechanical features (mean spine, rotational variability, front-of-center, stiffness index).
Pearson correlation analysis found mean spine to be the strongest predictor of shot grouping (r = 0.64), while rotational variability had negligible predictive value.
Wrote the methodology, data-processing, and results sections of the 20+ page report.
